_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("uid" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "login_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "associated_id" TEXT NULL, "password_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "password_salt" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uid"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "courses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "branches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "semesters" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "branch_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "semester_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "semester_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "students" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "roll_number" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "section_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "faculty" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "employee_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subjects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subject_mappings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "section_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "faculty_assignments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "faculty_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_mapping_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attendance_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "faculty_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "section_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_time" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_time" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attendance_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES attendance_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("session_id", "student_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "student_enrollments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "section_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "semester_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "academic_year" TEXT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "import_batches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "imported_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "imported_by" TEXT NULL, "record_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "school_results" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "level" TEXT NOT NULL, "board" TEXT NULL, "percentage" REAL NOT NULL, "passing_year" INTEGER NULL, "import_batch_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES import_batches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("student_id", "level"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "semester_results" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "semester_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "academic_year" TEXT NULL, "sgpa" REAL NULL, "percentage" REAL NULL, "cgpa" REAL NULL, "backlogs" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "import_batch_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES import_batches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("student_id", "semester_number"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subject_results" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "semester_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "subject_id" TEXT NULL, "subject_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "internal_marks" REAL NULL, "practical_marks" REAL NULL, "external_marks" REAL NULL, "total_marks" REAL NULL, "max_marks" REAL NULL, "grade" TEXT NULL, "passed" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("passed" IN (0, 1)), "attempt" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "import_batch_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES import_batches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("student_id", "semester_number", "subject_name", "attempt"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attendance_summaries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "semester_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "subject_id" TEXT NULL, "subject_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "classes_held" INTEGER NULL, "classes_attended" INTEGER NULL, "percentage" REAL NOT NULL, "import_batch_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES import_batches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("student_id", "semester_number", "subject_name"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assessments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "semester_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "subject_id" TEXT NULL, "subject_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "assessment_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "score" REAL NOT NULL, "max_score" REAL NOT NULL, "assessed_on" INTEGER NULL, "import_batch_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES import_batches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ml_models" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task" TEXT NOT NULL, "family" TEXT NOT NULL, "feature_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "bundle_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "synthetic" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("synthetic" IN (0, 1)), "recommended" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("recommended" IN (0, 1)), "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "imported_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "imported_by" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "predictions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "task" TEXT NOT NULL, "model_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "feature_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_semester" INTEGER NOT NULL, "probability" REAL NULL, "band" TEXT NULL, "value" REAL NULL, "lower" REAL NULL, "upper" REAL NULL, "features_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "contributions_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "synthetic" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("synthetic" IN (0, 1)), "generated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "generated_by" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "interventions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "author_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', "follow_up_on" INTEGER NULL, "prediction_id" TEXT NULL, "review_assessment" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
